rules.title: Santa Ana Algorithmic Rent Pricing Ban
rules.requirement: Landlords and apartment owners in Santa Ana are prohibited from using automated AI software or algorithmic devices to set rental prices, and violators face fines of $1,000.

coverage.summary: Applies to landlords and apartment owners using algorithmic pricing software in Santa Ana.

rules.quoted_span: To protect renters, city leaders have approved a new ordinance that stops apartment owners and landlords from using automated AI software to set rental prices.
